summary: 36-year-old climber rescued after dislodging a rock while descending a rock gully in Boulder Canyon; took partial cover as the rock rolled over him, narrowly escaping serious injury.
location: 33,800 block of Boulder Canyon Drive, Boulder Canyon
notes: Alpine Institute roundup (2020-12-03) citing Daily Camera / Boulder County Sheriff's Office release; Friday item pins to 2020-11-27.
